signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.disabledBody: This server does not accept new accounts. Ask an administrator for access.

errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.passwordTooShort: Use a password with at least 8 characters.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.signUpDisabled: Sign-up is closed on this server.
errors.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.socialSignUpDisabled: There is no account with this email, and sign-up is closed on this server.
errors.socialNotLinked: An account with this email already exists, but the provider hasn't verified the address. Sign in with your password.
errors.socialNoEmail: The provider didn't share an email address.
errors.socialFailed: Couldn't sign in with that account. Try again.
errors.ssoSignUpNotAllowed: This identity provider can't create an account for this email address. Ask your workspace owner to add you.
errors.passwordUnchanged: Choose a password different from the old one.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter the email of your account and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, we sent it a link to reset the password. The link works for {minutes} minutes.
forgotPassword.unavailableBody: This server can't send email, so passwords can't be reset by email. Ask an administrator for help.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.doneBody: Your password was changed, you were signed out everywhere and your connected apps were disconnected. Sign in with your new password.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.intro: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryIntro: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-step verification. Each code works once.
twoFactor.trustDevice: Don't ask again on this device for 30 days

sso.notFound: Single sign-on isn't set up for this email address. Sign in another way, or ask your workspace owner.

requiredPassword.title: Choose a new password
requiredPassword.intro: An administrator of this server asked you to choose a new password before you go on.
requiredPassword.emailed: An administrator of this server asked you to choose a new password. We sent a link to {email}; choose it there, then sign in with the new password.
